name: Web Vulnerability Scanning Against SocioProphet Public API Endpoints

sigma_access_log.title: Web Vulnerability Scanner Signatures in API Access Logs
sigma_access_log.description: Detects automated web vulnerability scanner patterns in HTTP access logs for SocioProphet public API endpoints. Based on TTP analysis: web_vuln is the most common offensive TTP in the SG security network (102/168 accounts mined). Common tools: sqlmap, nikto, nuclei, dirbuster, gobuster, ffuf, wfuzz, burpsuite scanner.
sigma_access_log.author: SocioProphet/SCOPE-D
falsepositives: Legitimate penetration testing with advance notice
Bug bounty researchers — if bounty program exists, add allowlist

cloudflare_rule.description: Cloudflare WAF managed rule group: OWASP Core Rule Set. Enable for all SocioProphet public endpoints. Block: SQLi, XSS, path traversal, scanner UA strings.

rate_limit_rule.description: Rate limit: >100 requests/min from single IP to /api/* → challenge. >500/min → block.

osquery.description: Detect active scanner processes on any host with access to SocioProphet infrastructure
osquery.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.cmdline, p.start_time FROM processes p WHERE p.name IN ('sqlmap', 'nikto', 'nuclei', 'ffuf', 'gobuster', 'wfuzz', 'dirb', 'dirsearch') OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sqlmap%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%nuclei%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ffuf%' ORDER BY p.start_time DESC LIMIT 20;

expectedEffect: Detect automated web vulnerability scanning against public endpoints before exploitation attempts. web_vuln is the dominant offensive TTP (102/168 accounts = 61% of the SG security cohort) — scanner activity against our surfaces should be treated as pre-attack reconnaissance.
falsePositiveRisk: MEDIUM — aggressive crawlers and some monitoring tools trigger UA-based rules. Rate-limit rule has higher false positive risk than UA matching. Tune threshold based on observed baseline traffic.
deploymentGate: Deploy UA + path detection immediately. Rate limiting requires baseline traffic analysis first — deploy with challenge before block.
rollbackPlan: If legitimate partner traffic is blocked, add IP allowlist. Never allowlist scanner UA strings.
